newsitem.title: FRANCE: Storm damages over 200 houses in Algerian Sahara.
newsitem.headline: Storm damages over 200 houses in Algerian Sahara.

text.p: Storm and floods swept the Algerian town of Tazrouk in the Sahara desert damaging more than 200 houses, Algeria's official news agency APS said on Wednesday.

The storm, described as unprecedented, swept over than 80 km (50 miles) of the Hoggar area in Tamanrasset province, some 1,200 km (750 miles) south of Algiers, said APS quoting local weather forecasters.
The agency made no mention of casualties.
